title: Conversion rate has dropped but the cause is unknown
prompt: The lead-to-paid conversion rate for an education course has dropped by 20%. Please set out a diagnostic and decision plan. No data has been provided on channel, period, sample size, price changes or the sales process.
hidden_evaluation: A passing answer should first clarify relative decline versus percentage points, the time window, sample size and channel structure; break the process down into traffic quality, reach, trial lesson, sales and price; should not assert a single cause outright; and should design data checks and a small-scale experiment.
critical_failures: Not distinguishing relative decline from percentage points
